name: The Game of The Playful
source:
The heroine loses her memory after waking up in a hospital and temporarily stays at a mountaintop villa. In the town, she can choose to stay at the villa and get to know the residents, or move out alone.

[From [url=https://poqiujcq.itch.io/where-memories-bloom]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
女主角在医院醒来后失去了记忆，暂时借住在山顶的一栋别墅中。在这座小镇里，她既可以选择留在别墅中结识同住的房客们，也可以选择搬出去独自生活。

[摘自[url=https://poqiujcq.itch.io/where-memories-bloom]itch.io[/url]]
